title: Track D claim record (spike form of the assurance profile, FM-D3)
description: A minimal claim shape, in the assurance-records.md sketch's vocabulary (the asr: prefix there is provisional). One file per claim, under <track>/claims/.

subject.description: The law or theorem this claim is about, e.g. elg:L15, elg:L16, TA1.

statedAs.description: The theorem's name in the theory source, e.g. Eligibility.some_value_spec.

statementDigest.description: sha256 of the normalised statement text (gate.py computes this; a changed digest under an unchanged subject/statedAs is an unreviewed restatement, S5).

scope.description: What the claim quantifies over, e.g. EveryList, EveryCandidate.

assumptionAudit.description: The prover's own assumption listing, verbatim (Rocq: Print Assumptions; Isabelle: thm_deps / the theory's sorry/oracle report). Empty string means none found.

defect.description: Set when this claim record documents a seeded-defect run (S1-S5), naming the defect id.
